latest_operational_comparison.qualification_caveat: Passes original user risk/power requirements but fails its stricter preregistered internal .00999 risk target; no replacement or repair has been accepted.

original_threefold_obstruction.scope: Old eight positive single-harmonic Bernoulli cases and their exact sign mirrors; arbitrary predictable angles, allocation and single-shot stopping, with every paid observation counted and .01 uniform null-report risk/.95 per-case correct stop.
original_threefold_obstruction.interpretation: Within this fixed model and case set, tuning the stopping rule or adaptively choosing more angles cannot meet3x. A different observation/task structure must first demonstrate greater accessible information.
original_threefold_obstruction.nontransfer: This certificate is not a theorem about every future FaultTune task and was not proved for the newer48-case independent grid.
